title: Design System: Plan de Packing · Pura Fruit

headline.purpose: One H1 per page; Baloo 2 700 with tight tracking.

title.purpose: Card and empty-state titles (CardTitle declares font-medium; Baloo 2 is loaded at 600/700 only, so it renders at 600).

stat.purpose: KPI values in stat cards; tabular; coral when negative.

body.purpose: Card content, tables, descriptions; reading lists capped at 65ch.

lead.purpose: Muted summary line under an H1, parts joined with ' · '.

label.purpose: Badges and secondary lines under table row titles.

shadows.name: card-ring
shadows.purpose: Resting card edge (ring-1 ring-foreground/10); replaces a shadow.

shadows.name: attention-ring
shadows.purpose: Card that needs a decision (plans waiting for approval).

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Button and badge hover/focus changes (Tailwind transition-all default).

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Page padding grows to 24px sides / 32px vertical.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Role nav inline instead of Sheet; list rows split state and action into columns; inputs drop to 14px.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Heading and filters share a row; 2fr/1fr card splits.

narrative.overview:
A calm, pale-grey working ground with white rounded cards on it, carrying numbers that plant staff must trust at a glance. The world is the Pura Fruit brand applied to an operations tool: a single field green does the speaking (primary actions, brand mark, highlighted plant names, focus), Baloo 2 gives headings a friendly, rounded warmth, and Nunito keeps body text soft and legible for non-technical staff. Everything else stays quiet so that state color can mean something.

Density is moderate and table-led. Pages are a stack of cards inside a 1280px column; the content inside cards is mostly shadcn tables with right-aligned tabular numerals. Meaning is carried by a strict three-tone state vocabulary (green within plan, amber waiting or changed, coral alarm) that is always paired with an icon or glyph and a text label, never color alone.

The system is built on shadcn/ui (radix-nova style) and Tailwind v4, with every color living in `app/theme.css` as OKLCH light and dark tokens. Dark mode is a first-class peer: the same roles remapped onto a green-tinted near-black, with the logo green (#3DBE5C) brightened for primary.
keyCharacteristics: Pale grey-green ground (#F3F4F2), white cards, hairline rings instead of shadows.
One brand green for action and emphasis; coral and amber reserved for state.
Baloo 2 for headings and key figures, Nunito for everything else.
Tabular, right-aligned numbers in every table and KPI.
Dark ink pill marks the active view or filter.
Light and dark themes defined from one token file.

rules.name: The Coral Is an Alarm Rule
rules.body: Coral appears only where something is wrong or needs a decision now: rejection, extra-shift risk, below-plan numbers, the pending counter. It is never decorative.

rules.name: The Amber Means Waiting-or-Changed Rule
rules.body: Amber marks something pending a decision or deviating from a default. A changed value shows as an amber chip with "(default X)" beside it.

rules.name: The Never Color Alone Rule
rules.body: Every state badge carries a Lucide icon and a text label; every below-plan cell carries a down arrow plus screen-reader text. Color reinforces; it never carries meaning by itself.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every numeric column and KPI uses `tabular-nums` and right alignment, so columns of jabas, workers, and hours line up digit for digit.

rules.name: The Heading Face Stays on Headings Rule
rules.body: Baloo 2 is for H1s, card titles, stat values, and the wordmark. Body, labels, buttons, and tables stay in Nunito.

rules.name: The Ring, Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces use a 1px foreground/10 ring; attention uses a 2px colored ring. Shadows are reserved for overlays that float above the page.

dos: **Do** take every color from the `app/theme.css` tokens via Tailwind utilities (`bg-primary`, `text-warning-foreground`); define new brand values only there, in light and dark.
**Do** pair every state color with a Lucide icon and a text label, and give below-plan numbers a down arrow plus `sr-only` text.
**Do** mark the active view or filter with the dark ink pill, and the current top-nav route with the secondary fill.
**Do** show values changed from a plant default as an amber chip with "(default X)".
**Do** separate cards from the ground with the white fill and a 1px ink/10 ring.
donts: **Don't** use coral for anything that is not an alert, rejection, below-plan figure, or pending counter.
**Don't** add shadows to cards or resting surfaces; shadows belong to dropdowns and sheets.
**Don't** set body text, buttons, or table cells in Baloo 2.
**Don't** use a solid coral fill for destructive buttons; use coral text on the 10% wash.
**Don't** hard-code hex or OKLCH values in components; that breaks the one-file rebrand and dark mode.
